regimen

When the vaccines were adminstered; divided in lower scores; e.g. 1_5_7 or 0_4_6,. Note that we assume that the start of the trial is on day 0, thus the regimen only shows the relationship between the days. In the given example, both regiments are in fact the same but differ in their start-day convention. Thus, regimen notation is kept as protocol. If given an placebo set value to N/A (not applicable).
